task: E1 — independent re-check of the single-entry / freezeout blocker (flags F1 and F15) against official Venetian sources
retrieved_by: session 9a45e995 (fetch of official URLs listed below)
question: Does any official Venetian document confirm single entry (no re-entry, no add-on) for the 2026 DeepStack Extravaganza events?
verdict: NOT CONFIRMED. The sheets read in this check are silent on the entry count; silence is not confirmation. The 2026 sheets also do not prohibit re-entry. Earlier official Venetian sheets state that re-entry is allowed. No row may be labelled single-entry on this evidence.

official_series_page.read: Chunk 1 of 4 only (the schedule table: events, dates, times, structure links). Chunks 2-4 were NOT read in this session. Chunk 1 contains no entry-policy wording.

official_2026_sheets_read.result: Silent on re-entry, add-on and entry count. Does NOT confirm single entry.

official_earlier_sheets_read_for_compari.title: $200 No Limit Hold'em Bounty $5,000 Guaranteed Prize Pool @ 6:10 PM (1Day)

official_earlier_sheets_read_for_compari.result: Official 2024 Venetian sheet states that re-entry is allowed. Series rules differ from 2026, so this does not set the 2026 policy, but it shows that re-entry is an explicit term on Venetian sheets, not an unstated default.

official_earlier_sheets_read_for_compari.title: $800 No Limit Hold'em UltimateStack (Day A+B+C @ 11:10 AM, Day 2 @ 11:00 AM)
entry_rules_verbatim: 10. Registration and Re-Entry is allowed for nine (9) levels and through the break.

official_earlier_sheets_read_for_compari.result: Official 2024 sheet: re-entry allowed (9 levels) plus the same Day 2 bagging clause used on 2026 multi-flight sheets. Shows that the 'may not play a subsequent flight' wording does not by itself mean single entry.
